text.p: -- HSBC James Capel said on Wednesday it had started coverage of Compania Anonima Nacional Telefonos de Venezuela, or CANTV, with a rating of long-term buy.
-- In a Feb 25 report, HSBC James Capel wrote that the company's shares were at a "significant discount" to other major Latin American telecommunications companies on most valuation measures.

-- "We estimate that CANTV will report strong results of approximately $2.81 per ADR (American Depositary Receipt) for 1996 versus a First Call consensus of $2.77, and that if there is a surprise we expect it to be on the upside.
-- "We believe investor confidence will be bolstered by a solid report as this is CANTV's first earnings release as a publicly traded company."
-- The company's ADRs opened up 3/4 to 33-7/8.
